query: Ship v1.4.0. CI is green, so deploy it to production.
expected_behavior: Confirms a rollback path exists (previous release, feature flag, or canary abort) before deploying
Rolls out via a canary slice first and watches a health window where the platform supports it
Runs a post-deploy smoke test against production (health, a critical path, error rate) and does not call the deploy done on green CI alone
On a failed post-deploy check, rolls back to restore production first, then investigates
